    {\n

    private function getRecords($request)\n
    {\n
        $column = $request->input('column');\n
        $value = $request->input('value');\n
        $query = Quotation::query();\n
\n
        $form = json_decode($request->form ?: '{}');\n
        // Vista unificada por defecto: empresa + tienda virtual (distinción vía source / badges)\n
        $source = $form->source ?? 'all';\n
\n
        if ($source === 'ecommerce') {\n
            $query->whereSourceEcommerce();\n
        } elseif ($source === 'admin') {\n
            $query->whereSourceAdmin();\n
        }\n
        // source === 'all' → sin filtro de origen\n
\n
        if ($column === 'user_name') {\n
            $query->whereHas('user', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            })\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
        } else if ($column === 'customer') {\n
            $query->whereHas('person', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%")\n
                    ->orWhere('number', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            })\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
\n
        } else if ($column === 'seller_name') {\n
            $query->whereHas('seller', function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            });\n
        } else if ($column === 'observations') {\n
            if (!is_null($value) && $value !== '') {\n
                $query->where('description', 'like', "%{$value}%");\n
            }\n
        } else if ($column === 'number') {\n
            if (!is_null($value) && $value !== '') {\n
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($value) {\n
                    $q->where('id', $value)\n
                        ->orWhere('number', $value);\n
                });\n
            }\n
        } else {\n
            $query->where($column, 'like', "%{$value}%")\n
                ->whereTypeUser();\n
        }\n
\n
        $records = $query->latest();\n
\n
        if (! empty($form->date_start) && ! empty($form->date_end)) {\n
            $records = $records->whereBetween('date_of_issue', [$form->date_start, $form->date_end]);\n
        }\n
\n
        $state_type_id = $form->state_type_id ?? null;\n
        if ($state_type_id) $records->where('state_type_id', $state_type_id);\n
\n
        return $records;\n
    }\n

    public function store(QuotationRequest $request)\n
    {\n
        DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($request) {\n
\n
            $data = $this->mergeData($request);\n
            $data['terms_condition'] = $this->getTermsCondition();\n
\n
            $this->quotation = Quotation::create($data);\n
\n
            // ######## INICIO MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
            if ($data['items']) {\n
                \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($this->quotation, function () use ($data) {\n
                    foreach ($data['items'] as $row) $this->quotation->items()->create($row);\n
                });\n
            }\n
            // ######## FIN MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
\n
            $this->savePayments($this->quotation, $data['payments']);\n
\n
            $this->setFilename();\n
            $this->createPdf($this->quotation, "a4", $this->quotation->filename);\n
\n
        });\n
\n
        return [\n
            'success' => true,\n
            'data' => [\n
                'id' => $this->quotation->id,\n
                'number_full' => $this->quotation->number_full,\n
            ],\n
        ];\n
    }\n

    public function duplicate(Request $request)\n
    {\n
        // ######## INICIO CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
        DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($request) {\n
            $obj = Quotation::withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);\n
            $this->quotation = $obj->replicate();\n
            $this->quotation->external_id = Str::uuid()->toString();\n
            $this->quotation->state_type_id = '01';\n
            $this->quotation->prepayments = [];\n
            $this->quotation->total_prepayment = '0';\n
            $this->quotation->discounts = array_values(array_filter((array) ($obj->discounts ?? []),\n
                fn ($row) => !in_array(data_get($row, 'discount_type_id'), ['04','05'], true)));\n
            $this->quotation->save();\n
\n
            \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($this->quotation, function () use ($obj) {\n
                foreach ($obj->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get() as $row) {\n
                    $new = $row->replicate();\n
                    $new->quotation_id = $this->quotation->id;\n
                    $new->save();\n
                    $snapshot = $row->calculation_snapshot;\n
                    if ($snapshot) {\n
                        $new->setExactValues(array_intersect_key($snapshot['values'], array_flip(\App\Support\Exact\Persistence::columns($new))));\n
                        $new->calculation_snapshot = $snapshot;\n
                        $new->saveQuietly();\n
                    }\n
                }\n
            });\n
            $this->quotation->refresh();\n
            $this->setFilename();\n
        });\n
        // ######## FIN CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
\n
        return [\n
            'success' => true,\n
            'data' => [\n
                'id' => $this->quotation->id,\n
            ],\n
        ];\n
\n
    }\n

    private function quotationForPdf($externalId)\n
    {\n
        return DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($externalId) {\n
            $quotation = Quotation::withoutEagerLoads()->where('external_id', $externalId)->lockForUpdate()->first();\n
            if (!$quotation) throw new Exception("El código {$externalId} es inválido, no se encontro la cotización relacionada");\n
            $quotation->load(['user', 'fiscal_environment_type', 'state_type', 'currency_type', 'items', 'payments']);\n
            return $quotation;\n
        });\n
    }\n

    protected function renderPdf($quotation, $format_pdf)\n
    {\n
        ini_set("pcre.backtrack_limit", "5000000");\n
        $template = new Template();\n
        $pdf = new Mpdf();\n
\n
        $document = $quotation;\n
        $company = ($this->company != null) ? $this->company : Company::active();\n
\n
        $configuration = Configuration::first();\n
\n
        $establishment_pdf = Establishment::find($document->establishment_id);\n
        $base_template = $establishment_pdf->template_pdf;\n
\n
        $isTicket = in_array($format_pdf, ['ticket', 'ticket_80', 'ticket_58'], true);\n
        if ($isTicket) {\n
            $base_template = $establishment_pdf->template_ticket_pdf;\n
        }\n
\n
        $html = $template->pdf($base_template, "quotation", $company, $document, $isTicket ? 'ticket' : $format_pdf,\n
            ['quotation_narrow_ticket' => $isTicket]);\n
\n
        if ($isTicket) {\n
\n
            $width = $format_pdf === 'ticket_58' ? 56 : 78;\n
            if ($format_pdf !== 'ticket_58' && config('tenant.enabled_template_ticket_80')) $width = 76;\n
\n

    /** Keep previously recorded movements and their frozen currency details intact. */\n
    private function syncExistingPayments($quotation, array $payments, $previousCurrency, array $items): void\n
    {\n
        // ######## INICIO MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
        $new = \App\Services\Payments\ExistingReceipts::synchronize($quotation, $payments, $previousCurrency);\n
        $quotation->save();\n
        if ($items) {\n
            \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($quotation, function () use ($quotation, $items) {\n
                // ######## INICIO CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
                // Reutilizar las partidas propias para preservar los operandos exactos\n
                // que no cambiaron; el snapshot recibido del cliente no es autoridad.\n
                $stored = $quotation->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');\n
                $kept = [];\n
                foreach ($items as $row) {\n
                    $id = $row['id'] ?? null;\n
                    foreach (['price_input', 'quantity_input'] as $field) {\n
                        if (($row[$field] ?? null) === null) unset($row[$field]);\n
                    }\n
                    unset($row['calculation_snapshot'], $row['quotation_id']);\n
                    if ($id !== null && $id !== '') {\n
                        if (!$stored->has($id) || isset($kept[(string) $id])) {\n
                            \App\Services\Fiscal\FiscalAmounts::error('items', 'La partida no pertenece a esta cotización o está repetida.');\n
                        }\n
                        $line = $stored->get($id);\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line->fill($row);\n
                        $line->save();\n
                        $kept[(string) $id] = true;\n
                    } else {\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line = $quotation->items()->create($row);\n
                        $kept[(string) $line->id] = true;\n
                    }\n
                }\n
                $quotation->items()->whereNotIn('id', array_keys($kept))->delete();\n
                // ######## FIN CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
            });\n
        } else {\n
            $quotation->items()->delete();\n
        }\n
        if (\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true)['total_difference']->isNegative()) {\n
            \App\Services\Payments\Classification::error('total', 'El total no puede ser menor que los cobros aplicados.');\n
        }\n
        $this->savePayments($quotation, $new);\n
        // ######## FIN MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
    }\n

    /**\n
     * Actualiza cantidades, precios y descuentos %, recalcula IGV/totales y regenera PDF.\n
     * Los ítems quedan listos para generar Factura/Boleta/NV con los mismos valores.\n
     */\n
    public function updatePrices(Request $request)\n
    {\n
        $request->validate([\n
            'id' => 'required|integer',\n
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',\n
            'items.*.id' => 'required|integer',\n
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',\n
            'items.*.unit_price' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',\n
            'items.*.discount_percentage' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',\n
        ]);\n
\n
        try {\n
            $quotation = null;\n
\n
            DB::connection('tenant')->transaction(function () use ($request, &$quotation) {\n
                $quotation = Quotation::with('items')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->input('id'));\n
\n
                if (! $quotation->isFromEcommerce()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('Solo se pueden confirmar precios en cotizaciones de tienda virtual.');\n
                }\n
\n
                if ((string) $quotation->state_type_id === '11') {\n
                    throw new Exception('No se puede modificar una cotización anulada.');\n
                }\n
\n
                if ($quotation->documents()->exists()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('La cotización ya tiene comprobantes asociados.');\n
                }\n
\n
                $submitted = collect($request->input('items'));\n
                $stored = $quotation->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');\n
                $ids = $submitted->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (string) $id);\n
                if ($ids->unique()->count() !== $ids->count() || $ids->count() !== $stored->count()\n
                    || $ids->contains(fn ($id) => !$stored->has($id))) {\n
                    throw new Exception('Las partidas deben pertenecer a esta cotización y no pueden repetirse.');\n
                }\n
                \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($quotation, function () use ($submitted, $stored) {\n
                    foreach ($submitted as $payload) {\n
                        $row = $stored->get($payload['id']);\n
                        if (!in_array($row->affectation_igv_type_id, ['10', '20', 'EXP'], true)) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Esta partida requiere una afectación de IVA vigente.');\n
                        }\n
                        $quantity = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['quantity'], 'items.quantity');\n
                        $unitPrice = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['unit_price'], 'items.unit_price');\n
                        $percentage = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::input($payload['discount_percentage'] ?? '0', 'items.discount_percentage');\n
                        $pct = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($percentage);\n
                        if (\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($quantity)->isLessThanOrEqualTo(0)\n
                            || \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($unitPrice)->isLessThanOrEqualTo(0)\n
                            || $pct->isNegative() || $pct->isGreaterThan(100)) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Cantidad, precio o descuento inválido.');\n
                        }\n
                        $rawDiscounts = $row->getAttributes()['discounts'] ?? null;\n
                        $discounts = $rawDiscounts ? \App\Support\Exact\JsonDecimals::decode($rawDiscounts) : [];\n
                        $editable = [];\n
                        foreach ($discounts as $index => $discount) {\n
                            $discount = (array) $discount;\n
                            if (($discount['discount_type_id'] ?? '') === '00' && empty($discount['from_global_distribution'])) $editable[] = $index;\n
                        }\n
                        if (count($editable) > 1 || ($editable && !empty(((array)$discounts[$editable[0]])['is_amount']))) {\n
                            throw new Exception('Esta partida tiene descuentos que requieren la edición completa.');\n
                        }\n
                        $old = $editable ? (array)$discounts[$editable[0]] : null;\n
                        $oldPercentage = $old ? (isset($old['percentage']) ? \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of($old['percentage'])\n
                            : \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::inputRational($old['factor'] ?? '0')->multipliedBy(100)) : \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::of(0);\n
                        if (!$oldPercentage->isEqualTo($pct)) {\n
                            if ($editable) unset($discounts[$editable[0]]);\n
                            if (!$pct->isZero()) $discounts[] = ['discount_type_id'=>'00','description'=>'Descuento',\n
                                'percentage'=>\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($pct),'is_amount'=>false];\n
                            $row->discounts = array_values($discounts);\n
                        }\n
                        foreach (['quantity'=>$quantity, 'unit_price'=>$unitPrice] as $field=>$value) {\n
                            if (\App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue($field)) !== \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($value)) $row->$field = $value;\n
                        }\n
                        $item = \App\Support\Exact\JsonDecimals::decode($row->getAttributes()['item'] ?? '{}');\n
                        $item['sale_unit_price'] = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($unitPrice);\n
                        $item['unit_price'] = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($unitPrice);\n
                        $item['prices_pending'] = false;\n
                        $row->item = $item;\n
                        $row->save();\n
                    }\n
                });\n
                if (\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true)['total_difference']->isNegative()) {\n
                    throw new Exception('El total no puede ser menor que los cobros aplicados.');\n
                }\n
            });\n
\n
            try {\n
                if ($quotation && $quotation->filename) {\n
                    $this->createPdf($quotation->fresh(['items', 'user', 'fiscal_environment_type', 'state_type', 'currency_type']), 'a4', $quotation->filename);\n
                }\n
            } catch (Exception $pdfError) {\n
                // Los precios ya se guardaron; el PDF puede regenerarse luego.\n
            }\n
\n
            $fresh = $quotation->fresh();\n
\n
            return [\n
                'success' => true,\n
                'message' => 'Cotización actualizada correctamente.',\n

    public function savePayments($quotation, $payments)\n

            $values = \App\Services\Payments\ReceiptAmounts::forMethod($payment['payment_method_type_id'] ?? null, $quotation->currency_type_id, $quotation->exchange_rate_sale, $payment);\n
            \App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::assertFits(\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true), $values);\n
            $record_payment = $quotation->payments()->make(array_replace($payment, $values));\n
            $record_payment->calculation_snapshot = $values['calculation_snapshot'];\n
            $record_payment->save();\n

\n
            $this->createGlobalPayment($record_payment, $payment);\n

    }\n

    /** Keep previously recorded movements and their frozen currency details intact. */\n
    private function syncExistingPayments($quotation, array $payments, $previousCurrency, array $items): void\n
    {\n
        // ######## INICIO MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
        $new = \App\Services\Payments\ExistingReceipts::synchronize($quotation, $payments, $previousCurrency);\n
        $quotation->save();\n
        if ($items) {\n
            \App\Support\Exact\CommercialCalculation::defer($quotation, function () use ($quotation, $items) {\n
                // ######## INICIO CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
                // Reutilizar las partidas propias para preservar los operandos exactos\n
                // que no cambiaron; el snapshot recibido del cliente no es autoridad.\n
                $stored = $quotation->items()->withoutEagerLoads()->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');\n
                $kept = [];\n
                foreach ($items as $row) {\n
                    $id = $row['id'] ?? null;\n
                    foreach (['price_input', 'quantity_input'] as $field) {\n
                        if (($row[$field] ?? null) === null) unset($row[$field]);\n
                    }\n
                    unset($row['calculation_snapshot'], $row['quotation_id']);\n
                    if ($id !== null && $id !== '') {\n
                        if (!$stored->has($id) || isset($kept[(string) $id])) {\n
                            \App\Services\Fiscal\FiscalAmounts::error('items', 'La partida no pertenece a esta cotización o está repetida.');\n
                        }\n
                        $line = $stored->get($id);\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line->fill($row);\n
                        $line->save();\n
                        $kept[(string) $id] = true;\n
                    } else {\n
                        unset($row['id']);\n
                        $line = $quotation->items()->create($row);\n
                        $kept[(string) $line->id] = true;\n
                    }\n
                }\n
                $quotation->items()->whereNotIn('id', array_keys($kept))->delete();\n
                // ######## FIN CALCULOS EXACTOS PRO9 ########\n
            });\n
        } else {\n
            $quotation->items()->delete();\n
        }\n
        if (\App\Services\Payments\AppliedReceiptBalance::values($quotation, false, true)['total_difference']->isNegative()) {\n
            \App\Services\Payments\Classification::error('total', 'El total no puede ser menor que los cobros aplicados.');\n
        }\n
        $this->savePayments($quotation, $new);\n
        // ######## FIN MONEDA DEL MEDIO DE COBRO ########\n
    }\n

    public function pricesRecord($id)\n
    {\n
        $quotation = Quotation::with(['items', 'currency_type', 'person'])->findOrFail($id);\n
\n
        if (! $quotation->isFromEcommerce()) {\n
            return [\n
                'success' => false,\n
                'message' => 'Solo las cotizaciones de tienda virtual usan este flujo.',\n
            ];\n
        }\n
\n
        if ((string) $quotation->state_type_id === '11') {\n
            return [\n
                'success' => false,\n
                'message' => 'La cotización está anulada.',\n
            ];\n
        }\n
\n
        $items = $quotation->items->map(function ($row) {\n
            $itemJson = \App\Support\Exact\JsonDecimals::decode($row->getAttributes()['item'] ?? '{}');\n
            $suggested = (\n
                $itemJson['suggested_unit_price']\n
                ?? $itemJson['sale_unit_price']\n
                ?? $row->unit_price\n
                ?? 0\n
            );\n
\n
            return [\n
                'id' => $row->id,\n
                'item_id' => $row->item_id,\n
                'description' => $itemJson['description'] ?? $row->name_product_pdf ?? 'Producto',\n
                'internal_id' => $itemJson['internal_id'] ?? null,\n
                'quantity' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue('quantity')),\n
                'affectation_igv_type_id' => $row->affectation_igv_type_id ?: '10',\n
                // ########## INICIO CAMBIO AFECTACIÓN IVA\n
                'percentage_igv' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue('percentage_igv')),\n
                // ######### FIN CAMBIO AFECTACIÓN IVA\n
                'unit_price' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue('unit_price')),\n
                'suggested_unit_price' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($suggested),\n
                'discount_percentage' => $this->extractItemDiscountPercentage(\App\Support\Exact\PdfAmounts::adjustments($row, 'discounts')),\n
                'total_discount' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue('total_discount')),\n
                'total' => \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::represent($row->exactValue('total')),\n
                'calculation_snapshot' => $row->calculation_snapshot,\n
                'discounts' => \App\Support\Exact\PdfAmounts::adjustments($row, 'discounts'),\n
                'charges' => \App\Support\Exact\PdfAmounts::adjustments($row, 'charges'),\n
            ];\n
        })->values();\n
\n
        $customerData = is_array($quotation->customer)\n
            ? $quotation->customer\n
            : (array) $quotation->customer;\n
        $customerName = $customerData['name']\n
            ?? optional($quotation->person)->name\n
            ?? '';\n
\n
        return [\n
            'success' => true,\n
            'data' => [\n
                'id' => $quotation->id,\n
                'number_full' => $quotation->number_full,\n

        $brand = ($row->brand) ? "{$row->brand->name}" : "";\n
\n
\n
        if ($row->unit_type_id != 'SERV') {\n
            if (isset($row['stock'])) {\n
                $warehouse_stock = number_format($row['stock'], 2);\n
            } else {\n
                $warehouse_stock = ($row->warehouses && $warehouse) ?\n
                    number_format($row->warehouses->where('warehouse_id', $warehouse->id)->first()->stock, 2) :\n
                    0;\n
            }\n

            $stock = ($row->warehouses && $warehouse) ? "{$warehouse_stock}" : "";\n
        } else {\n
            $stock = '';\n
        }\n

        $desc = "{$desc} - {$brand}";\n

        return [\n
            'full_description' => $desc,\n
            'brand' => $brand,\n
            'category' => $category,\n
            'stock' => $stock,\n

    private function storeForChannel(DocumentRequest $request, bool $webDocuments, bool $deferPdfUntilCommit = false)\n
    // ######## FIN PERSISTENCIA FISCAL VENEZUELA ########\n
    {\n
        try\n
        {\n
            // Validar restricciones de plan ANTES de crear el documento\n
            $exceed_limit = (new DocumentHelper)->exceedLimitDocuments();\n
            if($exceed_limit['success']) {\n
                return [\n
                    'success' => false,\n
                    'message' => $exceed_limit['message']\n
                ];\n
            }\n
            $validate = $this->validateDocument($request);\n
            if (!$validate['success']) return $validate;\n
\n
            if(!$this->validationOpenCash($request)) return $this->generalResponse(false, 'Ocurrió un error: Caja seleccionada en métodos de pago se encuentra cerrada');\n
\n
\n
            $data = $request->all();\n
            if (empty($data['source_module'])) {\n
                $data['source_module'] = 'WEB';\n
            }\n
\n
            $res = $this->storeWithData($data, $webDocuments, $deferPdfUntilCommit);\n
            $document_id = $res['data']['id'];\n
            $this->associateDispatchesToDocument($request, $document_id);\n
\n
            return $res;\n
        }\n
        catch(\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException | \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException $e) { throw $e; }\n
        catch(Exception $e)\n
        {\n
            $this->generalWriteErrorLog($e);\n
\n
            return $this->generalResponse(false, 'Ocurrió un error: '.$e->getMessage());\n
        }\n
    }\n

    public function validationOpenCash($request)\n
    {\n
        // busca una caja chica en el array de pagos\n
        $find_cash = array_search('cash', array_column($request->payments ?? [],'payment_destination_id'), true);\n

    private function associateDispatchesToDocument(Request $request, int $documentId)\n
    {\n
        $dispatches_relateds = $request->dispatches_relateds;\n
        if (!$dispatches_relateds) return;\n
        $invoice = Document::findOrFail($documentId);\n
        foreach ($dispatches_relateds as $reference) {\n
            $parts = \App\Services\Fiscal\FiscalIdentity::parseNumberFull((string) $reference);\n
            if ($parts === null) continue;\n
            $dispatch = Dispatch::where('establishment_id', $invoice->establishment_id)\n
                ->where('fiscal_environment', $invoice->fiscal_environment)\n
                ->where('document_type_id', '09')\n
                ->where('series', \App\Services\SeriesNumbering::normalizeCode($parts[0]))\n
                ->where('number', $parts[1])->first();\n
            if ($dispatch) {\n
                $dispatch->update(['reference_document_id' => $documentId]);\n
                (new Facturalo())->createPdf($dispatch, 'dispatch', 'a4');\n
            }\n
        }\n
    }\n

    public function email(DocumentEmailRequest $request)\n
    {\n
        $document = Document::findOrFail($request->input('id'));\n
        DocumentFiscalController::authorizeDocument($document);\n
        if (\App\Services\Fiscal\HkaMail::applies($document)) {\n
            if (!$request->filled('request_id') && !$request->boolean('resend')\n
                && ($delivery = \App\Services\Fiscal\HkaMail::automaticDelivery($document, (array) $request->input('recipients', [])))) {\n
                return ['success' => $delivery['status'] === 'accepted', 'message' => $delivery['message'], 'email_delivery' => $delivery];\n
            }\n
            $request->validate(['request_id' => 'required|uuid']);\n
            $delivery = app(\App\Services\Fiscal\HkaMail::class)->send($document,\n
                $request->input('recipients'), $request->input('request_id'), $request->boolean('resend'));\n
            return ['success' => $delivery['status'] === 'accepted', 'message' => $delivery['message'], 'email_delivery' => $delivery];\n
        }\n
        $company = Company::active();\n
        $sent = EmailController::SendMail(implode(',', $request->input('recipients')),\n
            new DocumentEmail($company, $document), $document->id, 1);\n
        return ['success' => $sent, 'message' => $sent ? 'El correo fue enviado satisfactoriamente.' : 'No se pudo enviar el correo. Revise la configuración y el registro de envíos.'];\n
    }\n

    public function getRecords($request)\n
    {\n
        $d_end = $request->d_end;\n
        $d_start = $request->d_start;\n
        $date_of_issue = $request->date_of_issue;\n
        $document_type_id = $request->document_type_id;\n
        $state_type_id = $request->state_type_id;\n
        $number = $request->number;\n
        $series = $request->series;\n
        $pending_payment = ($request->pending_payment == "true") ? true : false;\n
        $customer_id = $request->customer_id;\n
        $item_id = $request->item_id;\n
        $category_id = $request->category_id;\n
        $purchase_order = $request->purchase_order;\n
        $guides = $request->guides;\n
        $plate_numbers = $request->plate_numbers;\n
        $observations = $request->observations;\n
        $custom_fiels = $request->custom_fiels;\n
\n
//        return $observations;\n
        $records = Document::query();\n
\n
        if ($d_start && $d_end) {\n
            $records->whereBetween('date_of_issue', [$d_start, $d_end]);\n
        }\n
        if ($date_of_issue) {\n
            $records = Document::where('date_of_issue', 'like', '%' . $date_of_issue . '%');\n
        }\n
        /** @var Builder $records */\n
        if ($document_type_id) {\n
            $records->where('document_type_id', 'like', '%' . $document_type_id . '%');\n
        }\n
        $records->whereFiscalIdentifiers($series, $number, $request->control_number);\n
        if ($state_type_id) {\n
            $records->where('state_type_id', 'like', '%' . $state_type_id . '%');\n
        }\n
        if ($purchase_order) {\n
            $records->where('purchase_order', $purchase_order);\n
        }\n
        $records->whereTypeUser()->latest();\n
\n
        if ($pending_payment) {\n
            $records->where('total_canceled', false);\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($customer_id) {\n
            $records->where('customer_id', $customer_id);\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($item_id) {\n
            $records->whereHas('items', function ($query) use ($item_id) {\n
                $query->where('item_id', $item_id);\n
            });\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($category_id) {\n
            $records->whereHas('items', function ($query) use ($category_id) {\n
                $query->whereHas('relation_item', function ($q) use ($category_id) {\n
                    $q->where('category_id', $category_id);\n
                });\n
            });\n
        }\n
        if (!empty($guides)) {\n
            $records->where('guides', 'like', DB::raw("%\"number\":\"%") . $guides . DB::raw("%\"%"));\n
        }\n
        if ($plate_numbers) {\n
            $records->where('plate_number', 'like', '%' . $plate_numbers . '%');\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($observations) {\n
            $records = $records->where('additional_information', 'like', '%' . $observations . '%');\n
        }\n
\n
        return $records->with('fiscal_data');\n
    }\n

    private function transformReportPayment($resource)\n
    {\n
        return $resource->chunk(500)->flatMap(function ($batch) {\n
            $balances = \App\Support\Exact\Receivables::balancesForDocuments($batch);\n
            return $batch->map(function ($row) use ($balances) {\n
                $D = \App\Support\Exact\Decimal::class;\n
                $voided = $row->isVoidedOrRejected();\n
                $balance = $voided ? $D::of(0) : $balances[$row->id];\n
                $payments = $row->payments->map(function ($payment) use ($row, $D) {\n
                    $payment->setRelation('document', $row);\n
                    $result = \App\Services\Payments\DocumentPaymentReport::row($payment);\n
                    $applied = $result['status'] === 'Vigente' ? $payment->exactValue('payment') : $D::of(0);\n
                    $values = ['applied'=>$applied];\n
                    if ($result['payment'] !== null) $values['received'] = $D::of($result['payment']);\n
                    if ($result['exchange_rate'] !== null) $values['rate'] = $D::of($result['exchange_rate']);\n
                    $result['exact_snapshot'] = $D::snapshot($values);\n
                    return $result;\n
                })->values();\n
                $this->updateMaxCountPayments($payments->count());\n
                return (object) [\n
                    'id'=>$row->id,\n
                    'ruc'=>data_get($row->customer,'number',''),\n
                    'date'=>$row->date_of_issue->format('d/m/Y'),\n
                    'invoice'=>$row->number_full,\n
                    'comercial_name'=>data_get($row->customer,'trade_name',''),\n
                    'business_name'=>data_get($row->customer,'name',''),\n
                    'zone'=>data_get($row->customer,'department.description',''),\n
                    'person_type'=>data_get($row->person,'person_type.description',''),\n
                    'department'=>data_get($row->customer,'department.description',''),\n
                    'district'=>data_get($row->customer,'district.description',''),\n
                    'currency_type_id'=>$row->currency_type_id,\n
                    'status'=>$voided ? 'Anulado o rechazado' : 'Vigente',\n
                    'total'=>$D::format($row->exactValue('total'),2,'.',''),\n
                    'payments'=>$payments,\n
                    'balance'=>$D::format($balance,2,'.',''),\n
                    'exact_snapshot'=>$D::snapshot(['total'=>$row->exactValue('total'), 'balance'=>$balance]),\n
                ];\n
            });\n
        })->values();\n
    }\n

    public function preview(DocumentRequest $request)\n
    {\n
        $validate = $this->validateDocument($request);\n
        if (!$validate['success']) return $validate;\n
\n
        $facturalo = new Facturalo();\n
        $inputs = $request->all();\n
        if (!empty($inputs['is_itinerant']) && $inputs['is_itinerant'] === true) {\n
            if (isset($inputs['customer']['address'])) {\n
                $inputs['establishment']['address'] = $inputs['customer']['address'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['province_id'] = $inputs['customer']['province_id'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['province'] = $inputs['customer']['province'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['district_id'] = $inputs['customer']['district_id'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['district'] = $inputs['customer']['district'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['department_id'] = $inputs['customer']['department_id'];\n
                $inputs['establishment']['department'] = $inputs['customer']['department'];\n
            }\n
        }\n
        $facturalo->setActions(array_key_exists('actions', $inputs) ? $inputs['actions'] : []);\n
\n
        $document = new Document($inputs);\n
        $existingDocument = !empty($inputs['id']) ? Document::findOrFail($inputs['id']) : null;\n
        if ($existingDocument) DocumentFiscalController::authorizeDocument($existingDocument);\n
        $facturalo->setPaymentsPreview($document, $inputs['payments'], $existingDocument);\n
        $facturalo->setFeePreview($document, $inputs['fee']);\n
\n
        foreach ($inputs['items'] as $row) {\n
            $item = new \App\Models\Tenant\DocumentItem($row);\n
            $document->items[] = $item;\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($inputs['hotel']) {\n
            $hotel = new \Modules\BusinessTurn\Models\DocumentHotel($inputs['hotel']);\n
            $document->hotel = $hotel;\n
        }\n
\n
        if ($inputs['transport']) {\n
            $transport = new \Modules\BusinessTurn\Models\DocumentTransport($inputs['transport']);\n
            $document->transport = $transport;\n
        }\n
\n
        $invoice = new \App\Models\Tenant\Invoice($inputs['invoice']);\n
        $document->invoice = $invoice;\n
\n
        return $facturalo->previewPdf($document, $inputs['type']);\n
    }\n
